title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented study environments across Simpson Library, the Hurley Convergence Center, and the Cedric Rucker University Center.

cards.title: Simpson Library Individual Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Simpson Library — all three floors
cards.notes: Choose an individual study area on any library floor, then use campus wireless and nearby printing or copying when your work calls for it.
cards.short_summary: Flexible solo-study seating throughout Simpson Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMW states that Simpson Library has individual study areas on all three floors, campus wireless, printing, and copying.
cards.source_title: Simpson Library | University of Mary Washington Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located in Simpson Library; consult current library building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Simpson Library Group Work Tables
cards.subtitle: Simpson Library
cards.notes: Bring a project group to the library’s group-work tables and keep the session focused on shared notes, screens, and problem-solving.
cards.short_summary: Table seating designed for collaborative library work.
cards.evidence_claim: UMW lists tables for group work among Simpson Library’s study spaces.
cards.source_title: Simpson Library | University of Mary Washington Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located in Simpson Library; consult current library building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Simpson Library Reservable Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Simpson Library
cards.notes: Reserve a library study room for a defined group session, especially when you need a contained setting for discussion or shared coursework.
cards.short_summary: Bookable rooms for focused group sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: UMW identifies reservable study rooms as part of Simpson Library’s group and individual study spaces.
cards.source_title: Simpson Library | University of Mary Washington Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Reservations are required for planned use; check the library’s current room-booking system and eligibility rules.

cards.title: Simpson Library Sunrooms
cards.subtitle: Simpson Library
cards.notes: Settle into a sunroom’s soft seating for reading, outlining, or laptop work when a conventional desk is not what you need.
cards.short_summary: Soft-seating study spaces inside the library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMW describes Simpson Library’s sunrooms as cozy spaces with soft seating.
cards.source_title: Simpson Library | University of Mary Washington Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located in Simpson Library; consult current library building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Simpson Library Treehouses
cards.subtitle: Simpson Library — third floor
cards.notes: Use a double-decker treehouse carrel for a solo reading or writing block; bring only the materials you need to keep the setup simple.
cards.short_summary: Double-decker study carrels on the third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UMW identifies the treehouses as double-decker study carrels located on Simpson Library’s third floor.
cards.source_title: Simpson Library | University of Mary Washington Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Third-floor location in Simpson Library; consult current library building hours before visiting.

cards.title: HCC Computer Workstations
cards.subtitle: Hurley Convergence Center
cards.notes: Use an HCC computer workstation when your assignment needs campus hardware or software instead of a personal-device-only setup.
cards.short_summary: Campus computer access for technology-dependent work.
cards.evidence_claim: UMW’s Off-Campus Student Services lists computers at the Hurley Convergence Center as a study resource.
cards.source_title: Off-Campus Student Services | University of Mary Washington
cards.access_notes: Located in the Hurley Convergence Center; workstation availability and building access may vary.

cards.title: HCC Worktables
cards.subtitle: Hurley Convergence Center
cards.notes: Use an HCC worktable for spreading out course materials or collaborating face-to-face; pack up promptly when you finish.
cards.short_summary: Shared table workspace in the Hurley Convergence Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UMW’s Off-Campus Student Services lists worktables at the Hurley Convergence Center as a study resource.
cards.source_title: Off-Campus Student Services | University of Mary Washington
cards.access_notes: Located in the Hurley Convergence Center; table availability and building access may vary.

cards.title: HCC Private Rooms
cards.subtitle: Hurley Convergence Center
cards.notes: Plan a private-room session for concentrated work or a small collaboration, and use the linked room-reservation process before relying on one.
cards.short_summary: Private HCC rooms with a reservation path.
cards.evidence_claim: UMW’s Off-Campus Student Services lists private rooms at the Hurley Convergence Center and links to room reservations.
cards.source_title: Off-Campus Student Services | University of Mary Washington
cards.access_notes: Private rooms require checking the current HCC reservation process; availability is not guaranteed.

cards.title: CRUC Third-Floor Reading Nooks
cards.subtitle: Cedric Rucker University Center — third floor
cards.notes: Take a small reading nook for independent coursework or a quiet check-in with classmates, keeping the compact seating arrangement in mind.
cards.short_summary: Small chair-and-table nooks on the CRUC’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UMW says the CRUC third floor has several reading nooks with chairs and tables or groups of lounge chairs for studying.
cards.source_title: About the Cedric Rucker University Center | University of Mary Washington
cards.access_notes: CRUC academic-year building hours are listed as daily 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; hours change during breaks.

cards.title: Linden Terrace
cards.subtitle: Cedric Rucker University Center — fourth floor
cards.notes: Use Linden Terrace’s indoor soft furniture, tables, or rocking-chair balcony for coursework when the space is not booked for an event.
cards.short_summary: Indoor and balcony seating overlooking Ball Circle.
cards.evidence_claim: UMW describes Linden Terrace as having an outdoor balcony with rocking chairs plus indoor soft furniture and tables and chairs; it is open for seating when not booked.
cards.source_title: About the Cedric Rucker University Center | University of Mary Washington
cards.access_notes: Open for seating when not booked for an event; CRUC academic-year building hours are daily 7 a.m.–10 p.m.
